newsitem.title: UK: Sleepy Kids signs U.S Budgie deal with UAV.
newsitem.headline: Sleepy Kids signs U.S Budgie deal with UAV.

text.p: Sleepy Kids Plc said on Monday it had signed a five-year agreement with United American Video Entertainment Corp. (UAV) to distribute Budgie The Little Helicopter home videos throughout the U.S.

Sleepy Kids, a producer of children's animation films and merchandising group, said it had licensed to UAV the home video rights to all 39 Budgie episodes from the first three series and will shortly launch the first in a range of Budgie video titles.
Budgie the Little Helicopter is a children's storybook charcter created by Sarah Ferguson, the former wife of Britain's Prince Andrew.
